newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bourse expects over 100 new firms in '97.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bourse expects over 100 new firms in '97.

text.p: The Shanghai stock exchange expects to list more than 100 new companies in 1997 to bring the total number of listed firms on the bourse to 400 by the end of the year, the Wen Hui Bao daily said on Friday.
The exchange aims to improve its services to attract high-quality, promising companies, the newspaper quoted exchange president Yang Xianghai as saying.
The exchange listed a record 105 firms last year and had 293 listed companies by the end of 1996.
Securities authorities late last year said they would approve and issue a record number of shares in 1997 to help offset speculation on China's two stock markets in Shanghai and in southern Shenzhen.
